dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: I'm craving a drink... I really need to go and have a proper one later!

dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: Alcohol! Of course — a big glass of strong liquor! I work this hard every day just so I can afford to drink every day... otherwise, who would even want to work?

dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: Alright, I won't keep you. I should finish this delivery quickly, then I can rest for a few days again.

dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: That's just how I am when I'm working. I'm usually like this — only when I'm drinking do I feel truly happy.

dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: But that's not really a good thing. You know, alcohol gives you happiness... and also pain.

dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: If I had another chance in life, I'd never touch a drop. But this life...

dialogues.speaker: Matvey
dialogues.text: If you ever need anything moved or carried, you can always come find me.
